scope: Workbench and standalone-player log copy UI; clipboard contents checked in a real headless Chromium browser.

definition.source: Current selected port retained buffer, including platform events duplicated into that view. No cross-port merge.
definition.record: Nonempty logical line after ANSI removal; CR/CRLF normalize to LF; trailing partial record counts; internal blank separators retained.
definition.timestamp: Existing firmware text is preserved; no host timestamps added.

firmware.method: ROM boot to PLATFORM_READY stopwatch. Send 70 individually acknowledged UART1 lines containing controlled timestamps and ANSI colors; guest GPS_RX output appears on UART0. Pause before copying.

tests: 3 i18n tests passed, including all static HTML strings

reproduction: Serve the checkout with a static server and open web/platform/index.html?lang=zh-CN. Supply the WASM and ROM artifacts described in the platform README.
Use the documented espTester API to configure m5stack-stopwatch with the local diagnostic manifest and start. Wait for PLATFORM_READY, send numbered UART1 lines, wait for each guest echo, then pause.

Grant test-context clipboard read/write permission. Click Copy logs and each range; compare navigator.clipboard.readText() with the selected raw buffer after ANSI removal, preserving original timestamps.

Check port change, clear/empty, ArrowDown/End/Enter/Escape, outside dismissal and a 390 px viewport. Force clipboard.writeText rejection for the legacy fallback, then reject execCommand too for the error notice. Restore both methods.
Open embed.html?lang=en in the same owned context, boot the same diagnostic and copy Last 100 entries from its 58-line boot log. Close the owned browser and preview server.
environmentNotes: The first local server load reset one module connection; reloaded with a larger accept backlog before functional checks. No application code change was needed for that local-server failure.
evidenceRetention: Raw screenshots and console/test logs remain in ignored output. No browser profile, host identity or unrelated process inventory retained; no external evidence upload.
